title: Dynamical generalizations of Chowla's conjecture on short averages
summary: In 1965, Chowla conjectured that the signs of the Liouville function become asymptotically uncorrelated at any fixed collection of distinct shifts. In 2015, Matomäki, Radziwiłł and Tao proved an averaged form of Chowla's conjecture. In 2022, Lichtman proved a variant of this conjecture over primes on average. In the same year, Lichtman and Teräväinen proved the Hardy--Littlewood--Chowla conjecture on average.
